sections.description: Watch the story, learn the new words, then play and answer.

sections.title: Games
sections.description: Browser games for warm-ups, icebreakers, and first-day fun.

items.title: 5 Seconds Challenge
items.description: Fast-paced game-show style rounds across 7 levels — letters, memory, acting, and brain teasers, all against a 5-second timer.

items.title: Mystery Box Game
items.description: 25 mystery boxes, each hiding a fun icebreaker question or dare — great for getting students talking on day one.

items.title: Mystery Picture
items.description: Reveal a hidden picture tile by tile, use clues, and guess what it is — three difficulty levels plus a teacher mode.
